title: tvbuff: convert helper methods to pinfo->pool
description:
A few of them just needed scratch memory, so allocate and free it
manually after doing any exception-raising checks.

A few others were returning memory, and needed conversion to accept a
wmem scope argument.

`packet` in the function name was originally part of `wmem_packet`, indicating that the string was in the `wmem_packet_scope()` scope.  Now that the scope is an argument, and `wmem_` was removed, `packet` is just hanging there.

Should this be renamed `tvb_bcd_dig_to_str()`?
Yes, good catch.
